evals.prompt: Create a new agent skill called 'api-contract-linter' to validate OpenAPI specifications against enterprise REST guidelines.
evals.expected_output: Scaffolds skills/api-contract-linter with SKILL.md, scripts/, references/, manifest.yaml, skill-card.json. Generates testing.md and evals.json. Runs evaluator-skill for quality scorecard.
assertions: Generates a complete Spec 1.0 compliant skill directory with all required artifacts

evals.prompt: Create a custom SDD bundle for kubernetes-operator development with 4 lifecycle phases.
evals.expected_output: Scaffolds 4 interconnected skills: kubernetes-operator-specify, kubernetes-operator-plan, kubernetes-operator-implement, kubernetes-operator-verify.
assertions: Creates all 4 SDD lifecycle skills with proper cross-references

evals.prompt: Optimize the trigger description for skills/csv-analyzer to improve activation recall.
evals.expected_output: Generates test queries, evaluates triggers, iteratively improves the description using train/test split to prevent overfitting.

evals.prompt: Package skills/csv-analyzer into a distributable .skill file for sharing.
evals.expected_output: Validates the skill, excludes dev files, bundles into a .skill ZIP archive.

evals.prompt: Compare two versions of the csv-analyzer skill using blind A/B comparison.
evals.expected_output: Runs both versions, uses blind comparator to score outputs, then unblinds and provides improvement suggestions.
